notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
V 1.6

Updated UI with an improved look on the Start screen
Added Play Screen for different game modes
Leaderboard has been moved to the death screen for easy access during play

New Monthly challenge!
April challenge is live now, each monthly challenge gives a different mix of hydras, abilities and arenas to fight. Who can get to the top of the leaderboard by the end of the month?

Solar Spirits now cause explosive splash damage to nearby enemies

Graphics have been updated to be less sharp


The Shillelagh Game +OST Bundle is out now! Enjoy the amazing metal score!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24857/Shillelagh__OST/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24857/Shillelagh__OST/[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.content:
tweaks: Audio balancing between SFX and MUSIC

Updated Tutorial

Solar Spirits now return in a larger radius

More tree variation and new textures

bug fixes

Thanks for playing! I hope youll take a look at the scoreboard after trying and see where you land in the community

notes.title: v 1.4
notes.content: closed the settings menu and restored to original start menu
- reset all data button added. please use ONLY in case you want to reset your high score locally. Leaderboard has been reset due to game rebalancing and I cannot wait to see your new scores

notes.title: quick patch 1.2.1
notes.content: quick patch for wave counting /leaderboard bug and seed bug.

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2

Thank you all who played Shillelagh during the launch week!

I've been listening to feedback and working to incorporate your suggestions into the game. These are the changes that are in this launch.

[list]
[*] waves and time now on screen during play
[*] achievement added!
[*] updated shaders and effects on the Solar Spirits and tree leaves
[*] rebalanced gameplay- changed enemy drops, speed, heath, and Waves
[*] slow-motion effect on pause and death
[*] big tree added
[*] bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you again for playing and all of your feedback- I'm so grateful to this fledgling community for all the support. feel free to comment with more ideas and feedback because I plan to continue to improve this game.

notes.title: patch version 1.1 November 10th, 2021
notes.content:
version 1.1 November 10th, 2021 

Thank you for playing Shillelagh on launch day!

notes.title: Shillelagh
notes.content:
Shillelagh (Shil-lay-lah) is a fast-paced arena shooter inspired by classic FPS's like Doom and Devil Daggers. You are a druid tasked with holding back the darkest terrors of the deepest hells, using your magic shillelagh to defend against the endless heads of the undead hydra monster that can even destroy the ground you walk upon. Only by calling upon the aura of nature can this threat be kept at bay.

The Demo Features the first 10 waves of monsters. The Full Game features:

Brutal procedural levels that get smaller the more enemies you face
High Score Leaderboard
Hand-drawn artwork and animations
Crunchy metal soundtrack by John Fio
